_comment: Licence of each model in models.json, read from its model card (README front matter) at the pinned revision. When a pin in models.json moves, read the new card and change the revision and licence here; tests/test_third_party_notices.py fails until they match. A model whose licence is unverified, non-commercial or research-only blocks the release (P-014b) because the app is sold.

whisper-turbo.licence: MIT (upstream OpenAI card; this card states none)
whisper-turbo.note: The card at the pinned revision states no licence. It is a conversion to MLX of OpenAI Whisper large-v3-turbo, whose card (openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo) says MIT, read 2026-11-01. Treated as MIT; ask the repository owner to add the licence to the card.
